_about: Resource facts the v2 virtual Pip (KIVORI_VIRTUAL_BOARD=rp2040-zero) reports in its Device internals, for the catalog product firmware (physical-st7789 release ELF, thumbv6m). The `elf` block is generated from `bun scripts/firmware-budget.mjs --json` and checked against the current ELF by `bun scripts/virtual-resource-facts.mjs --check` (just fw-budget, firmware CI); refresh with `--write`. The `board` block is not in the ELF: it is the RP2040-Zero's flash (one 2 MiB W25Q16, no partition table, so the whole flash is the application's, as `chip_probe.rs` reports it). See docs/virtual-pip.md (Virtual boards, Modelled timing and internals).
